statement: In acute scalene $\triangle ABC$, the external bisector of $\angle BAC$ meets $BC$ at $X$. Lines $\ell_b$, $\ell_c$ are the tangents to $(ABC)$ at $B$, $C$. A line through $X$ meets $\ell_b$, $\ell_c$ at $Y$, $Z$. $(AYB)\cap(AZC)=N$, $\ell_b\cap\ell_c=D$. Show $ND$ bisects $\angle YNZ$.

In simple connected graph $G$, let $x_i$ = number of vertices with degree $i$, and $d>3$ the max degree. Prove that if $x_d\geq x_{d-1}+2x_{d-2}+\cdots+(d-1)x_1$, there exists a degree-$d$ vertex whose removal keeps $G$ connected.

Positive integers $a,b,c,d$ with $abcd\neq 1$, pairwise coprime. Multiplicative $f,g:\mathbb{N}\to\{0,1\}$ with $f(an+b)=g(cn+d)$ for all $n$. Prove: either $f(an+b)=g(cn+d)=0$ for all $n$, or there exists $k$ such that $f(n)=g(n)=1$ whenever $\gcd(n,k)=1$.

Let $\Omega(n)$, $\omega(n)$ be the largest and smallest prime factors of $n$. Alireza and Amin play: Alireza picks 1400 integer polynomials, Amin picks 700. Amin wins if $\max_{P\in A}(\Omega(P(n)))\geq\min_{P\in B}(\omega(P(n)))$ for all $n$. Who wins?
A triple of reals is nice if one is the average of the other two. Given $2k+1$ distinct reals with $k^2$ nice triples, prove they can be split into two arithmetic progressions with equal ratio.

$D$ on the Euler line of $\triangle ABC$, inside the triangle. $E,F$ are where $BD,CD$ meet $AC,AB$. $X$ on line $AD$ with $\angle EXF=180^\circ-\angle A$, $A$ and $X$ on the same side of $EF$. $P$ is the second intersection of circumcircles of $CXF$ and $BXE$. Prove $XP$, $EF$ meet on the $A$-altitude.
Natural numbers fill an infinite grid so that each cell equals the number of its (8-neighbor) adjacent cells with the same number. Find the maximum number of distinct values.
Find all $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that $f(n)+1400m^2\mid n^2+f(f(m))$ for all $m,n$.

Prove there exist coprime polynomials $P(x),Q(x)\in\mathbb{Z}[x]$ and $u>0$ such that if positive integers $a,b,c,d$ satisfy $\left|\frac{a}{c}-u\right|^{2021}\leq\frac{u}{|d||c|^{1010}}$ and $\left|\left(\frac{a}{c}\right)^{2020}-\frac{b}{d}\right|\leq\frac{u}{|d||c|^{1010}}$, then $bP(a/c)=dQ(a/c)$.
Find all $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{R}$ such that for all positive integers $a,b,c$: $f(ac)+f(bc)-f(c)f(ab)\geq 1$.

$X$ inside non-trapezoid $ABCD$ with $\angle AXD+\angle BXC=180^\circ$. The bisector of $\angle ABX$ meets the $D$-altitude of $\triangle ADX$ at $K$, and the bisector of $\angle DCX$ meets the $A$-altitude of $\triangle ADX$ at $L$. Given $BK\perp CX$ and $CL\perp BX$. If the circumcenter of $\triangle ADX$ lies on $KL$, prove $KL\perp AD$.

Prove we can color every $n$-element subset of a $3n$-element set using 8 colors such that there are no three subsets $A,B,C$ of the same color with $|A\cap B|\leq 1$, $|A\cap C|\leq 1$, $|B\cap C|\leq 1$.
